en.name: Oleg Ponamarchuk
about: Frontend Developer with **4 years of experience**. I use **AI agents daily in software development** and integrate AI-powered features into products, including streaming chat interfaces, tool calling, structured outputs, and RAG interfaces.
**Built and trained a factory agent** to create widgets for the Stripo product, automating the entire workflow from Jira task intake to pull request creation.

**Delivered an [email signature generator](https://stripo.email/signature-generator-tool/create-email-signature/) to production in just 2 weeks.** The product remains easy to maintain thanks to the adoption of **Spec-Driven Development, Context Engineering, and Agentic Workflows**.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
points: Designed and built a maintainable SPA product with AI assistance — an **[email signature generator](https://stripo.email/signature-generator-tool/create-email-signature/) delivered to production in just 2 weeks**, developed in Vue using an **AI Spec-Driven Development** approach.
Worked on the [stripo.email](https://stripo.email/) website:
Identified key project stages and completed a website refactoring project in **3 weeks using AI**.
**Reduced website build time from 30 minutes to 4 minutes (7.5× faster)**, making future website scaling easier.
**Improved SEO and LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) performance by 2.5×**, enabling a **1,500% increase in indexed pages (16×)** without compromising Web Vitals.
Created and maintain [plugin documentation](https://plugin.stripo.email/), eliminating the need for a third-party documentation service and **saving up to ~$200/month**:
Partially reduced the support team's workload by **designing and developing an AI chat assistant for technical documentation**, with end-to-end management of search and generation quality.
**Built a full-cycle AI agent for documentation updates.** Cost: approximately **$0.20 per task**, saving **2 hours on regular tasks and up to 6 hours on larger tasks**.

en.expertise: **UX/UI expertise** with the ability to define requirements for design systems. **Over 4 years of experience working as a designer.** Hold Anthropic and Microsoft certifications in AI.
